_limitations: Passthrough mode — the bridge does not interpret Sonic Pi paths. Whatever you send under `/sonicpi/...` is forwarded verbatim (with `/sonicpi` stripped) to Sonic Pi. Your Sonic Pi code matches the resulting path via `sync :osc:/...` or `live_loop` patterns. Replies (any OSC reaching the bridge's reply_port) are re-emitted with `/sonicpi/` prefix to the bridge's clients.
